scope: Energy-tool calibration and inventory migration only. Synthetic independent-clock native SRAM testbenches; not a SoC workload, total chip power or physical qualification.

20.scope:
Calibrate the SRAM activity reader against native models and a real inventory.

This constructs a separate testbench containing the netlist's SRAM instances,
with known controls and independent A/B clocks. It does NOT simulate the SoC
workload and its energy numbers must never be quoted as SoC power.

limits: Complete macro inventory is taken from the exact flattened mapped netlist.
Native models are unchanged and all 8 joint MEN/WEN/REN states are measured at each functional clock port.
Only clock internal energy and scalar cell leakage are priced; input/mask/output switching and physical parasitics are omitted.
Missing/ambiguous/X activity is rejected, not replaced with zero.
Historical six-macro arithmetic requires explicit opt-in and is not relabelled as a current-image result.
